conversion_rule: SNK Neo Geo buttons + motions -> Tekken-style inputs. A (LP)=1, C (HP)=2, B (LK)=3, D (HK)=4. f/b/d/u directions map directly. qcf/qcb/hcb/hcf/qcb+hcf/qcf,qcf/hcb,hcb motions preserved. Charge motions noted, Tekken input keeps the end direction+button. Close-only throws = 1+3-family. Colliding inputs get a ~variant suffix on the key only; entry.input keeps the true input.
limb_convention: 1=armR(LP), 2=armL(HP), 3=legL(LK), 4=legR(HK); input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input

d,u+1.name: Rising Tackle
d,u+1.notes: charge d,u+A/C, EX OK; spinning rising attack

hcb,hcb+3+4.name: Star Dunk Volcano
hcb,hcb+3+4.notes: Climax; supercharged Power Dunk into crater geyser

hcf+3.name: Power Charge
hcf+3.notes: hcf+B/D, EX OK; shoulder block charge

qcb+3.name: Crack Shoot
qcb+3.notes: qcb+B/D, EX OK; spinning body kick

qcf+1.name: Power Wave
qcf+1.notes: qcf+A/C, EX OK; ground wave projectile
